race.comment: CHALKY (2) jumped from a low draw and boxed on well to finish second last time, beaten 1.75 lengths (22.57) behind Scott Enigma at Ballarat. Key chance in this line up. STAR OF VENUS (1) turned spotting a big start finishing sixth (23.66) last time in a Grade 4/5 at Geelong. Form at the trip sound including 16 wins. The form out of his last race has been franked. One of the main contenders. LIGHTNING RANGE (6) produced a moderate run last time when seventh at Warragul over 400m behind Compare Bubble (23.23) in a Grade 5. Worth another chance. Something for the Multiples: THERMAL FLAME (9)
